answers.explanation: The new leader may be missing them.
Clock skew can make it pick the wrong one.
One follower's view only moves forward.
Route by lag, not just liveness.
Fast, but unflushed writes can be lost.
Out-of-order updates can leave the cache wrong forever.
Prefill from a snapshot or the hottest keys.
One-off reads can't displace frequently used keys.
It needs dependency tracking, not coordination. Linearizability needs coordination.
